note: Fictional supplier catalogue. Most suppliers are ordinary candidates; the anchor suppliers below are placed deliberately so every documented eligibility and ranking behaviour can be asserted against the canonical requirement.

scenarios.name: Lowest cost bidder
scenarios.description: The cheapest eligible supplier for the canonical requirement (unit price 55 EUR).
scenarios.expects: With all weight on cost this supplier ranks #1; under the default weights it is eligible but does not necessarily win.

scenarios.name: High-risk supplier
scenarios.description: Risk score 85. Passes every other constraint for the canonical requirement.
scenarios.expects: Ineligible at 'low' and 'medium' risk tolerance; eligible at 'high' tolerance.

scenarios.name: Does not supply the material
scenarios.description: An otherwise excellent supplier that does not list MAT-1000.
scenarios.expects: Ineligible for the canonical requirement because of the material-match filter.

scenarios.name: Weak ESG score
scenarios.description: ESG score 35, below a typical sustainability floor.
scenarios.expects: Eligible for the canonical requirement; ineligible once a sustainability requirement of 70 is set.

scenarios.name: No active contract
scenarios.expects: Eligible for the canonical requirement; ineligible once a contract requirement is set.

scenarios.name: Insufficient capacity
scenarios.description: Available capacity 40, below the canonical requested quantity of 100.
scenarios.expects: Ineligible for the canonical requirement because capacity cannot cover the quantity.

scenarios.name: Contract expiring before delivery
scenarios.description: Holds an active contract, but it expires 2026-09-01, before the canonical required delivery date of 2026-10-01.
scenarios.expects: Eligible for the canonical requirement, but its contract score is penalised to the 'expiring' level and its risks list the lapse.
